children: X4 Pharmaceuticals announced the FDA agreed to reduce the 4WARD Phase 3 sample size to 126 while accepting the proposed safety database and targeting enrollment completion by year-end 2026.
FDA agreed reduction of 4WARD sample size from 176 to 126, preserving power for co-primary endpoints.
Co-primary endpoints: reduction in annualized infection rate and positive ANC response remain adequately powered.
FDA indicated proposed safety database is acceptable to support a potential sNDA for mavorixafor.
With new CRO, X4 expects to complete enrollment by end of 2026 and report topline data in H1 2028.

title: X4 Pharmaceuticals: FDA OKs Reduced Sample Size for 4WARD Phase 3, Enrollment to Finish by Year-End 2026
